dedupe_keys.name: suryabench benchmark dataset for advancing machine learning in heliophysics and space weather prediction

description: SuryaBench: Benchmark Dataset for Advancing Machine Learning in Heliophysics and Space Weather Prediction is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sujit Roy et al. This paper introduces a high resolution, machine learning-ready heliophysics dataset derived from NASA’s Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO), specifically designed to advance machine learning (ML) applications in solar physics and space weather forecasting. The dataset includes processed imagery from the Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA) and Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager (HMI), spanning a solar cycle from May 2010 to December 2024. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: CSV, NetCDF, HDF5, ZIP. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
